name: Rumble
author: Henning Berge
description: Controller rumble in the style of Going Commando, which Ratchet & Clank never had: hits taken, the Thruster-Pack's long jump and wall jumps, wrench hits and the wrench slam, kills and broken crates, every weapon's shot (a steady buzz while the Pyrocitor, Tesla Claw or Morph-o-Ray fires), explosions and anything else that shakes the camera, rails and the Hydro-Pack's dash, and (off by default) a faint hum while a pack holds Ratchet up. The waves play on Going Commando's own vibration mixer, copied from its decompilation. Quiet in menus, scenes and while Ratchet is dead. Needs OpenRAC with mod interface 1.37.

settings.name: Strength
settings.description: How strong the rumble is, in percent: the large motor's strength scales; the small motor, which is only on or off, drops out below about 40%.

settings.name: Hits taken
settings.description: A jolt for each hit Ratchet takes (stronger for a heavier one), and a long one as he dies.

settings.name: Jumps
settings.description: A kick as the Thruster-Pack's long jump starts, and a lighter one for a wall jump, where Going Commando kicks for its own.

settings.name: Wrench and kills
settings.description: A knock when the wrench connects, a thump as the wrench slam strikes the ground, and a short one for each enemy killed or crate broken.

settings.name: Weapons
settings.description: A kick for each shot, by weapon: light for the Blaster, heavier for the Bomb Glove and Walloper, strongest for the Devastator and the R.Y.N.O., and a steady buzz while the Pyrocitor, Tesla Claw or Morph-o-Ray fires.

settings.name: Explosions and camera shake
settings.description: Rumble with the camera's shake, as strong as the shake: explosions near the camera, quakes, the game's scripted shakes.

settings.name: Rails and swimming
settings.description: A low rattle while Ratchet grinds a rail, and a steady push while the Hydro-Pack dashes him under water.

settings.name: Hover hum
settings.description: A faint, steady hum while the Thruster-Pack's hover or the Heli-Pack's glide holds Ratchet up. Not Going Commando's: it has none.
